integrity: Subset-nucleus bijection and Booleanity of the ordered assembly are credited to earlier authors. The new object is composition commutation, which is not the lattice meet or join.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem is proved for arbitrary finite posets only; finite experiments corroborate rather than certify the general proof. A prior equivalent in less accessible composition-of-nuclei literature cannot be excluded.
title: Universal composition-commutation of nuclei on finite Heyting frames
